slides.headline: Ladakh Bans Poll Protests in Leh, Kargil Before 21 Nov

slides.stat_label: Kinds of Political Protest Barred in Leh, Kargil
bullets: Protests, dharnas, demonstrations, sit-ins, hunger strikes, rallies
Election officer's order covers parties, candidates and workers
It says they could intimidate or unduly influence voters
slides.credit_line: Sources: Chief Electoral Officer's order via ETV Bharat (PTI), The Tribune

slides.stat_label: Police Escort Sonam Wangchuk Home From Leh Protest
bullets: Police say he was advised to stay home
Police cite orders on protests in Leh municipal limits
He was protesting to defer the 4 December polls
slides.credit_line: Sources: Ladakh Police via The Tribune, ETV Bharat (PTI)

slides.stat_label: Winter Low Wangchuk Cites for Delaying the Polls
bullets: A week of December snow is forecast, he says
Many residents winter in warmer places, Ladakh's MP says
Leh Apex Body, Kargil Democratic Alliance back a delay
slides.credit_line: Sources: The Tribune, ETV Bharat (PTI), The Indian Express
